parsed.rationale: The 'Crypto News_v11 - Get Crypto news from Single Website' API directly provides news articles from specific tech-related websites, fitting the subtask to query selected tech blogs/news sites for articles. It accepts a 'website' parameter which can be bound from the 'source_list' input. Other APIs are either unrelated (quotes) or too broad/general or unrelated to technology news.
